##### Project general facts

Sakura Gardens is a resort-style residential concept inspired by the harmony and symbolism of cherry blossoms, offering a sanctuary where balance, connection, and a sense of belonging define everyday life. Designed as a place where calm meets contemporary living, the project focuses on creating an environment where life flows effortlessly between people, homes, and nature, shaping a lifestyle that celebrates peace, clarity, and authentic human connection.

The community is thoughtfully planned around meaningful interaction, wellbeing, and real neighborhood living. Here, mornings begin with natural light, weekends unfold in green communal spaces, and neighbors become part of your story. Built as a true home from the very first day, Sakura Gardens prioritizes privacy, space, and a serene pace of life, offering a gentle environment that nurtures simplicity, wellness, and genuine community spirit.

Sakura Gardens delivers a full spectrum of resort-grade amenities curated across wellness, active living, social spaces, leisure experiences, outdoor escapes, and smart comfort. Residents enjoy wellness studios, meditation gardens, saunas, rooftop relaxation areas, lagoon-style pools, gyms indoors and outdoors, jogging trails, padel courts, creative studios, co-working rooms, kids’ themed worlds, BBQ zones, cafés, boutique retail, and a vast pedestrian green park with over 30,000 sqm of landscaped nature. Every space is designed to restore, inspire, and elevate daily living.

Residences at Sakura Gardens come with fully furnished interiors, natural tones, and contemporary layouts that create a seamless indoor–outdoor living experience. Floor-to-ceiling glass, extended balconies, and soft organic design elements ensure bright, airy spaces, while smart-home systems, sustainable features such as solar integration, recycled-water irrigation, EV charging, and underground parking bring modern comfort to every home. Each apartment and townhome is crafted to offer clarity, serenity, and effortless living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

At the heart of Dubailand is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubailand also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits.
